summary: Victory Capital Holdings filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 furnishing a press release on monthly client assets. As of August 31, 2026, total AUM was $356.5 billion, other institutional assets $3.7 billion, and total client assets $360.2 billion, up from $348.8 billion at July 31. Average August total AUM was $353.2 billion. The filing contains no transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics, so no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
